problem: F is described as "total number of free frames" which is misleading; proportional allocation works with the total number of frames available for allocation, not only the free ones.
fix: Change the description to: "Let F be the total number of frames that can be allocated to processes (i.e., the sum of all frames currently available for use)."

problem: Rounding each F_i to the nearest integer can make the sum of allocated frames differ from F, but the text does not mention how to handle the discrepancy.
fix: Add a note: "After rounding, adjust the allocations (e.g., give or take a frame from the process with the largest fractional remainder) so that the total allocated frames equals F."
